appearance.identity: Eight sloping blue-gray glass shards with uneven tips, open steel crown and eastern podium wings.
appearance.exclusions: Interiors, underground works and neighboring city blocks.

brief: Compact Shard exterior preserves all eight independently mapped facade planes, their unequal tips, recessed enclosure, exposed crown steel and eastern podium. Coarser tiers merge panel grids; original detailed master remains reproducible.

sourceFacts.reviewScope: Original269299-triangle24077148-byte source reproduced exactly; detailed original recipe preserved. Independent browser derivatives retain the distinguishing exterior with tiered detail.

geographic.notes: One inspected operator aerial exterior photograph confirms the pointed glass pyramid, separated facade edges and visibly open steel crown. Preserve original309.6m top control, eight independently mapped sloping planes with unequal tips, shifted occupied center and70/74m eastern podium wings. Existing exact-QID outer frame and facade parts establish the signed orientation; standard viewer PMTiles confirms the London Bridge road/building context. Off-footprint PMTiles point[-60,0]4.2538m sets approximate terrain contact; center3.0748m remains coarse. Raw heights are separate from a bounded preview contact correction. Exact glass bay schedule, tip fabrication, steel sections and entrances remain approximations. Separate station blocks and interiors excluded.
